title: If you've lost your creative genius, watch this
description:

0:00 I feel brain fried
3:37 You don’t have ideas because there’s too much interference.
5:17 Conditioning is the enemy of wonder.
7:03 Productivity as a priority is a losing game.
9:34 Infinite input and zero processing time.
12:05 The Next Challenge: Build A 2-Hour Content System
13:36 You’re not bored, you’re overstimulated.

15:42 The brain will upregulate dopamine receptors when deprived.

18:30 Day 1-2: Reduce The Input Fast
20:19 Day 3-4: Digest What’s Already There
23:10 Day 5-6: Become Interested In Life Again
26:12 Day 7: Create With What’s Emerged
